name: Head Counter
summary: Tracks server and CLI installer downloads from public Automaton releases, excluding our own checks.

application.description: Keeps daily public server installer and CLI download snapshots and subtracts our reported downloads.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp main.py index.html page.js dist/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js dist/ui/

secrets.name: HEAD_COUNTER_TOKEN
secrets.description: Shared secret of at least 16 characters for own-download reports and summary.json.
